intro:
A compact label for status, a count or a state.

Set `count` for a notification bubble and `shape="dot"` for a bare status dot.

It only shows — nothing about it is pressable. Use [Chip](/docs/components/chip) for the interactive version: a filter, a tag, a removable token.
notes: `count` clamps at `99+` so the pill keeps its shape, and sets an "N unread" accessibility label. Passing `count` implies `shape="count"` unless you set a shape yourself.

examples.title: Status labels
examples.description: The default shape — a pill with a text label.

examples.title: A count
examples.description: `shape="count"` sizes to a number. Pass `count` and it renders the digits for you.
examples.code:
<Badge shape="count" count={3} variant="destructive" />

{/* Clamp it yourself for large numbers. */}
<Badge shape="count" count={Math.min(unread, 99)} />

examples.title: A bare dot
examples.description: No label at all — an unread marker beside a title.
examples.code:
<View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
  <Text weight="medium">Inbox</Text>
  <Badge shape="dot" variant="info" />
</View>

examples.title: With a status dot
examples.description: A small dot inside the badge, for a status row.
examples.code:
<Badge variant="success">
  <View className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: '#10b981' }} />
  Operational
</Badge>
